name: claude-code-toolkit
description: Umbrella marketplace. Each plugin lives in its own repo; this just points at them.

plugins.name: visual-plan
plugins.description: Renders every plan as an interactive page before the approval dialog: file tree, per-file what/why/how cards, flowchart, and old-vs-new UI previews. Offline, no dependencies.

plugins.name: challenger
plugins.description: Conservative-skeptic session mode. Challenges your decisions and the existing code when warranted, stays silent when the code is fine. Persists across /clear and restarts. Levels: lite, full, ultra.

plugins.name: apply-improvements
plugins.description: Capture-now/review-next self-improvement loop. A SessionEnd hook queues what happened with zero judgement; a skill later audits it across five config surfaces and applies only the edits you approve.
